method_notes: Automatic metrics (normalized exact match, word 5-gram Jaccard, closest match by difflib char ratio over top word-Jaccard candidates) were run on a first draft, followed by a manual keyword search of all 2,898 unique training prompts for each prompt's topic words, because short prompts share few 5-grams and paraphrases are missed by surface metrics. Prompts with an exact, near-exact or same-situation training match were rewritten; 'prompts' below is the final set. Training files: the distillation jsonl for o_amp, o_sup, n_amp, n_sup and ctrl (amp/sup files of a trait share the same 1,930 prompts). Remaining thematic similarity (e.g. setbacks, waiting) is expected for trait-situation prompts and was kept.
